summary: Reviewed the full patch (3 files: CHANGES.txt, src/java/org/apache/cassandra/cql3/PasswordObfuscator.java, test/unit/org/apache/cassandra/cql3/PasswordObfuscatorTest.java) under the concurrency checklist at refdir/.claude/skills/shallow-review/references/general/specialists/concurrency.md. The change replaces an inline regex with Pattern.quote() over a CQL-escaped password. PasswordObfuscator holds only static final constants (OBFUSCATION_TOKEN, PASSWORD_TOKEN) and stateless static methods, so there is no shared mutable state, locking, lifecycle, or resource to clean up. The checklist items on races, visibility, locking, lifecycle, state management, counters and state machines do not apply. The new test helpers use only local variables. Nothing was skipped in the patch. Not reviewed: files outside the diff.
